name: Asset Classification
definition: Other classification type of the security, ie, other than ISO 10962.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI) codification, for example, common share with voting rights, fully paid, or registered.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: Language in which the asset classification is expressed.

ClassificationSubType.name: Classification Sub Type
ClassificationSubType.definition: Provides information about the sub-class according to one of the segmentation criteria.

Asset.name: Asset
Asset.definition: Asset for which classification information is provided.

AssetClassScheme.name: Asset Class Scheme
AssetClassScheme.definition: Information regarding the entity that assigns the asset classification.

Strategy.name: Strategy
Strategy.definition: Strategy related to a class of assets.
